goal: Build a tabletop bimanual reach scene with Unitree G1 humanoid: G1 standing in front of table, both hands reach to two cubes. Maps to GR00T sim-to-real bimanual demo. Realizes Phase 8 yrkesroll #1 (ML/RL persona). Asset: G1 from NVIDIA SimReady catalog.
thoughts: G1 = NVIDIA-shipped humanoid asset, available via import_robot(format='asset_library'). Anchored as fixed base (no locomotion in this canonical, just bimanual reach).
Tabletop scene: 1.5m × 0.6m table. G1 stands with hip at z=0.95 (G1 nominal hip height ~1.0m).
Two target cubes: Cube_left at table (-0.20, 0.40, 0.835), Cube_right at (+0.20, 0.40, 0.835).

2026-05-28 J1: setup_bimanual_pick_place_controller composes 2× cuRobo per-arm planners (LEFT then RIGHT) with plant_feet=True anchoring the lower body via USD FixedJoints. This sidesteps WBC runtime requirement (deferred to a separate phase per docs/notes/2026-05-28-g1-humanoid-impl-scope.md P3).

Function-gate semantics: 1 cube each delivered to /World/Bin would be ideal; for V0 sequential, the LEFT arm runs to completion, then RIGHT arm picks (accept either cube reaching the drop bin via cube_paths).
code:
create_prim(prim_path="/World/DomeLight", prim_type="DomeLight")
set_attribute(prim_path="/World/DomeLight", attr_name="inputs:intensity", value=1000.0)
create_prim(prim_path="/World/Ground", prim_type="Cube", position=[0, 0, -0.5], scale=[20, 20, 1])
apply_api_schema(prim_path="/World/Ground", schema_name="PhysicsCollisionAPI")

create_prim(prim_path="/World/Table", prim_type="Cube", position=[0, 0.40, 0.40], scale=[0.75, 0.30, 0.40])
apply_api_schema(prim_path="/World/Table", schema_name="PhysicsCollisionAPI")

set_physics_scene_config(config={"enable_gpu_dynamics": False, "broadphase_type": "MBP"})

import_robot(file_path="G1", format="asset_library", dest_path="/World/G1")
teleport_prim(prim_path="/World/G1", position=[0, -0.20, 0.95])

create_prim(prim_path="/World/Cube_left", prim_type="Cube", position=[-0.20, 0.40, 0.835], size=0.05)
create_prim(prim_path="/World/Cube_right", prim_type="Cube", position=[0.20, 0.40, 0.835], size=0.05)
for cube in ["/World/Cube_left", "/World/Cube_right"]:
    for api in ("PhysicsRigidBodyAPI", "PhysicsCollisionAPI", "PhysicsMassAPI", "PhysxRigidBodyAPI"):
        apply_api_schema(prim_path=cube, schema_name=api)

create_bin(prim_path="/World/Bin", position=[0, -0.45, 0.75], size=[0.30, 0.20, 0.15])

setup_bimanual_pick_place_controller(
    robot_path="/World/G1",
    robot_family="g1_arm",
    left_arm_sources=["/World/Cube_left"],
    right_arm_sources=["/World/Cube_right"],
    left_destination="/World/Bin",
    right_destination="/World/Bin",
    coordination_mode="sequential",
    plant_feet=True,
    planning_obstacles=["/World/Table"],
    ee_offset=[0.0, 0.0, 0.10],
)
extension_notes: First humanoid canonical. Requires NVIDIA G1 SimReady asset (available via import_robot asset_library). 2026-05-28 J0+J1 unblocks: cuRobo per-arm planner (g1_arm family + arm_scope) and setup_bimanual_pick_place_controller composing 2× per-arm cuRobo. plant_feet=True uses USD FixedJoint on ankle_roll_links — sidesteps WBC runtime (deferred to scope-doc P3).
failure_modes: G1 asset path resolution — NVIDIA Nucleus may not be configured locally

G1 SimReady asset URDF/USD may use slightly different link names than cuRobo unitree_g1.yml expects (cross-check at MotionPlanner build, falls through soft when lock_joints joint missing in articulation)
Kit RPC single-tenant — V0 supports sequential coordination only; parallel falls back with warning (see kit-concurrency memory)
G1 dex hand grasp dynamics V0 uses surface-gripper FJ-attach; real dex grasping deferred to future phase
